extensions.builtin-bc3-importer: Import Spanish FIEBDC-3 estimates and price books (.bc3): chapters, items with measurements and labour, equipment and material compositions.
extensions.builtin-onlv-importer: Import Austrian ÖNORM A 2063 bills of quantities (.onlv), including groups, items, quantities and labour/other prices, and standard-text catalogues (.onlb).
extensions.builtin-bascalc-importer: Import estimates from BasCalc/BasData Excel files (.xls, .xlsx), including direct costs, surcharges and company details.
extensions.builtin-wpcalc-importer: Import WpCalc (.calc) estimates, including chapters, items, surcharges and rate groups from the Access database.
extensions.builtin-inschrijfstaat-importer: Import RAW bid schedules from Excel files (.xls, .xlsx), including specification items, quantities and prices.
extensions.builtin-wpcalc-exporter: Export estimates to WpCalc (.calc) Access files, including chapters, items, surcharges and rate groups.
extensions.builtin-xtb-importer: Import IBIS-TRAD (.xtb) SQLite estimates, including chapters, items, resources and hourly-rate codes.
extensions.builtin-dnc-importer: Import STABU estimates from .dnc archives, including chapters, items, labour, materials, subcontracting, hourly rates and surcharges.
extensions.builtin-rsx-importer: Import RAW specifications from .rsx files and convert specification items, chapters and quantities to Open Calc Studio format.
